name: scMINER
method_summary: scMINER is a mutual information-based systems biology framework for single-cell transcriptomics that combines MI-based clustering, cell type-specific TF and signaling-gene network inference, and hidden-driver activity analysis. The selected integration mirrors its network-inference path, where scMINER prepares homogeneous-cell expression and candidate-driver files for SJARACNe, and SJARACNe reconstructs directed driver-target networks with mutual-information edge weights and correlation-derived signs.

threading.upstream_mapping: No safe public mapping from ANDREA --threads to the selected scMINER/SJARACNe network-inference path was found. scMINER's R functions expose no worker count. SJARACNe local mode documents parallel execution through cwltool --parallel, but does not expose a bounded worker/thread count; the wrapper requires --threads=1, runs sjaracne local with --serial, and keeps BLAS/OpenMP-style environment variables at 1.

compatibility_rules.message: scMINER/SJARACNe requires at least two expression genes to infer driver-target edges.
scMINER/SJARACNe requires at least two expression columns because mutual-information and correlation statistics cannot be estimated from a single cell/sample.
scMINER warns that SJARACNe needs at least 100 single cells to generate a high-quality single-cell network.
downSample_N below 100 can force scMINER below its stated high-quality single-cell network recommendation.
scMINER built-in driver resources are available only for human (hg, NCBI 9606) and mouse (mm, NCBI 10090). Use driver_source=custom_tf_list with a compatible tf_list for other declared taxa.
species_type=hg uses scMINER's human driver list and requires dataset.organism.ncbi_taxon_id=9606 when a taxon id is declared.
species_type=mm uses scMINER's mouse driver list and requires dataset.organism.ncbi_taxon_id=10090 when a taxon id is declared.

conditional_required.message: groups is required when execution.mode=group_emulated because ANDREA partitions the dataset by group before running the selected scMINER/SJARACNe network path.
conditional_required.usage: ANDREA uses groups.tsv to create one scMINER child run per group. The wrapper accepts a groups.tsv covering the full dataset or just the current expression matrix, subsets it to the expression columns being executed, and uses it only to assign public group:<id> contexts; scMINER/SJARACNe itself does not consume groups.tsv in the selected wrapper contract.

conditional_required.message: tf_list is required when driver_source=custom_tf_list because the wrapper passes those genes as scMINER customDriver_TF and SJARACNe candidate hubs.
conditional_required.usage: The wrapper validates tf_list.txt against expression gene ids, passes matching entries as the candidate TF driver list, and runs the TF-only SJARACNe path with those public gene identifiers.

progress.note: The selected public path consists of scMINER-style input preparation plus one or more SJARACNe local --serial runs. Upstream logs expose coarse CWL/workflow phases, but no stable bounded progress callback or thread-counted task stream; the wrapper reports coarse lifecycle states in progress.json and preserves upstream logs.

driver_source.description: Candidate-driver source for SJARACNe hubs. built_in_tf_sig, built_in_tf and built_in_sig use scMINER's built-in human/mouse TF and/or signaling-gene resources according to species_type. custom_tf_list requires tf_list and runs the TF-only custom-driver path.

species_type.description: Species code used by scMINER getDriverList() when driver_source uses built-in driver resources: hg for human and mm for mouse. Ignored when driver_source=custom_tf_list.

downSample_N.description: Maximum number of expression columns retained before writing SJARACNe input. An integer preserves scMINER's downsampling behavior for groups larger than the threshold; null passes no downsampling and preserves all columns.

oneOf.description: Downsample groups with more columns than this value to exactly this many columns.
Use null to skip scMINER downsampling, matching generateSJARACNeInput(downSample_N=NULL).

n_bootstraps.description: Number of SJARACNe bootstrap networks passed to the public CLI as -n. scMINER's generated commands and network-inference benchmarks use 100.

consensus_pvalue.description: SJARACNe consensus p-value threshold passed as -pc. The selected non-metacell single-cell path uses 1e-2 by default.

random_seed.description: Seed passed to scMINER's sampling step before optional downsampling.

artifacts_aux.description: Combined wrapper, scMINER and SJARACNe stdout/stderr log.
Resolved scMINER/SJARACNe parameters, execution mode, selected driver source, input dimensions, installation commits and runtime thread decision.
Public expression gene id to upstream-safe gene id map used to round-trip every source and target in network.csv back to ANDREA ids.
SJARACNe expression matrix files generated by the selected scMINER network-input path before running the upstream CLI.
Candidate driver hub lists supplied to SJARACNe after built-in or custom-driver resolution.
Raw SJARACNe directed network file(s) before conversion to ANDREA network.csv.
SJARACNe CWL workflow input file emitted by sjaracne local, preserving resolved expression, driver, p-value, depth and bootstrap settings for each upstream run.
